# Active work — raw-autotune

Live work, grouped by parent in `ROADMAP.md` order. Blocked work names its blocker inline.

## Unparented

### Candidate D: calibrated HueSatMap and opt-in vivid preset

`active` · `@raw-autotune.work.calibrated-hue-sat-table-candidate-d/5`

Evaluate and, if justified, implement a DCP-style hue/saturation lookup table applied after the colour matrix, per Candidate D of docs/PURPLE_SKY_PROBLEM_SCOPE.md. This is the full closure path for the residual look gap between faithful matrix rendering and the desired saturated, hue-shaped look.

Data source is settled: CamSDD has no colour chart; a ColorChecker is not available; the ART/RawTherapee SONY ILCE-7C.dcp is ProfileCopyright=public domain (not Adobe). The explicit --hue-sat-map <dcp> path stays available, strength 0 is an exact no-op, and the table is applied in ProPhoto HSV after the matrix. Bundled file: profiles/SONY_ILCE-7C.dcp with attribution in profiles/README.md.

User-facing policy: auto remains the archive default. The former punchy grade is named standard. The opt-in vivid preset uses the same standard tone grade plus the bundled HueSatMap. This is a named creative selection, not unattended enablement and not part of archive-auto-v8. The old punchy spelling remains a compatibility alias.

Remaining work is to decide when a photographer should choose standard versus vivid, informed by held-out Sony sky/JPEG comparisons and checks that legitimate saturated blues and sunsets are not neutralized.
